items.hebrew: איתא בזוהר הקדוש (זהר חדש בראשית יח) ואלו דבריו [מתורגם]: יש חיוב על ישראל בשעה שעולה עמוד השחר לקום ולהתגבר בשירות ותשבחות לפני הקב"ה, מהו הטעם? מפני שהם לוקחים את השירה אחר מלאכי השרת והקב"ה מצוי עמהם למטה, וזהו שכתוב; "ומשחרי ימצאונני". ואמר רבי יהודה; ובלבד שלא יפסיק משיתחיל עד שיתפלל עם הנץ החמה. עכ"ד.
items.translation: The holy Zohar says (Zohar Ḥadhash, Bĕreʾshith 18), in translation: Israel has a duty, at the hour when dawn rises, to get up and rouse themselves with songs and praises before the Holy One, blessed is He. Why? Because they take up the song after the ministering angels, and the Holy One, blessed is He, is there with them below. That is the meaning of the verse "those who seek Me early will find Me." And Ribbi Yĕhudha said: as long as you do not break off, once you have begun, until you pray at sunrise. So far the Zohar.

items.hebrew: ובאמת שכך נהגו בדור הקודם רבים ושלמים, וכן סדרו בקשות בסידורים קודם התפלה, ובדורנו הרי הם מיחידי סגולה, ולכן לא הבאנו כאן "שירי בקשות" כפי שהודפס בסידורים הישנים. ברם ראיתי בקהילות יוצאי בבל שעדיין נשאר אצלם שמץ כל דהו, שאומרים קודם התפלה — אף שלא אומרים אותו בעמוד השחר — פזמון "אדון עולם", ובשבת יש מוסיפים פזמון "יום השבת אין כמוהו", ואחר כך "ושמרו בני ישראל" וכו'. ואומרים אחריו "אמר ר' יהודה אשרי מי שעמלו בתורה" וכו', "רבי חנניא" וקדיש "על ישראל".
items.translation: And in truth, many fine and upright people did just this in the previous generation, which is why the siddurim set out baqashoth before the service. In our generation those who do so are a rare few, so we have not printed the "songs of baqashoth" here as they appeared in the old siddurim. Still, I have seen that the communities of Babylonian origin keep a faint trace of it: before the service — though not at dawn — they say the pizmon ʾĂdhon 'Olam, and on Shabbath some add the pizmon Yom HashShabbath ʾEn Kamohu, followed by Wĕshamĕru vĕne Yisraʾel. After that they say "Ribbi Yĕhudha said: Happy is the one who toils in Torah", then "Ribbi Ḥănanya", and Qaddish 'Al Yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: סימן: שם הויה ב"ה. להרב אלעזר אזכרי ז״ל
items.translation: Acrostic: the four-letter Name, blessed be He. By Rabbi ʾEl'azar Azikri, of blessed memory.

items.hebrew: יְדִיד נֶפֶשׁ אָב הָרַחֲמָן, מְשֹׁךְ עַבְדָּךְ אֶל רְצוֹנָךְ. יָרוּץ עַבְדָּךְ כְּמוֹ אַיָּל, יִשְׁתַּחֲוֶה מוּל הֲדָרָךְ. כִּי תֶעֱרַב לוֹ יְדִידוּתָךְ, מִנֹּפֶת צוּף וְכָל־טָעַם.
items.translation: Beloved of the soul, compassionate Father, draw Your servant to Your will. Your servant then will run as runs the deer, and bow before Your majesty; for sweeter is Your love to him than honey dripping from the comb, than any taste.
items.translit: yĕdhidh nefesh ʾav haraḥăman, mĕshokh 'avdakh ʾel rĕṣonakh. yaruṣ 'avdakh kĕmo ʾayyal, yishtaḥăweh mul hădharakh. ki the'ĕrav lo yĕdhidhuthakh, minnofeth ṣuf wĕkhol-ṭa'am.

items.hebrew: הָדוּר נָאֶה זִיו הָעוֹלָם, נַפְשִׁי חוֹלַת אַהֲבָתָךְ. אָנָּא אֵל נָא רְפָא נָא לָהּ, בְּהַרְאוֹת לָהּ נֹעַם זִיוָךְ. אָז תִּתְחַזֵּק וְתִתְרַפֵּא, וְהָיְתָה לָּהּ שִׂמְחַת עוֹלָם.
items.translation: Majestic, lovely, radiance of the world, my soul is sick with love for You. Please, God, I beg You, heal her now, by showing her the sweetness of Your light. Then she will gather strength and will be healed, and hers will be a joy that never ends.
items.translit: hadhur naʾeh ziw ha'olam, nafshi ḥolath ʾahăvathakh. ʾannaʾ ʾel naʾ rĕfaʾ naʾ lah, bĕharʾoth lah no'am ziwakh. ʾaz tithḥazzeq wĕthithrappeʾ, wĕhayĕtha lah simḥath 'olam.

items.hebrew: וָתִיק יֶהֱמוּ רַחֲמֶיךָ, וְחוּסָה נָּא עַל בֵּן אֲהוּבָךְ. כִּי זֶה כַמָּה נִכְסֹף נִכְסַף, לִרְאוֹת בְּתִפְאֶרֶת עֻזָּךְ. אָנָּא אֵלִי מַחְמַד לִבִּי, חוּשָׁה נָּא וְאַל תִּתְעַלַּם.
items.translation: Faithful One, let Your compassion stir, and have pity on the son You love. How long, how deeply he has yearned to see the splendor of Your might! Please, my God, my heart's delight, come quickly, and do not hide Yourself away.
items.translit: wathiq yehĕmu raḥămekha, wĕḥusa naʾ 'al ben ʾăhuvakh. ki zeh khamma nikhsof nikhsaf, lirʾoth bĕthifʾereth 'uzzakh. ʾannaʾ ʾeli maḥmadh libbi, ḥusha naʾ wĕʾal tith'allam.

items.hebrew: הִגָּלֶה־נָא וּפְרֹשׂ חָבִיב, עָלַי אֶת סֻכַּת שְׁלוֹמָךְ. תָּאִיר אֶרֶץ מִכְּבוֹדָךְ, נָגִילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה בָךְ. מַהֵר אָהוּב כִּי בָא מוֹעֵד, וְחָנֵּנִי כִּימֵי עוֹלָם.
items.translation: Reveal Yourself, my Dear One, and spread over me the shelter of Your peace. Let the earth shine bright with Your glory; we will rejoice and be glad in You. Hurry, Beloved, for the time has come, and show me grace as in the days of old.
items.translit: higgaleh-naʾ ufĕros ḥaviv, 'alay ʾeth sukkath shĕlomakh. taʾir ʾereṣ mikkĕvodhakh, naghila wĕnismĕḥa vakh. maher ʾahuv ki vaʾ mo'edh, wĕḥonneni kime 'olam.

items.hebrew: סימן: ישראל.
items.translation: Acrostic: Yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: יָחִיד וְאֵין בִּלְתּוֹ אַחֵר, אֵל בְּשִׁירֵי זִמְרָה בּוֹחֵר.
items.translation: He is One alone, and there is none besides Him — God, who chooses songs of praise.
items.translit: yaḥidh wĕʾen bilto ʾaḥer, ʾel bĕshire zimra boḥer.

items.hebrew: יוֹשֵׁב בִּשְׁמֵי שְׁמֵי זְבוּל, וּמַצְמִיחַ כָּל־עֵץ יְבוּל, גָּדוֹל בְּלִי חֵקֶר וּגְבוּל, יוֹם יוֹם פָּנֶיךָ אֲשַׁחֵר.
items.translation: You who dwell in heaven's highest heights, and make each fruitful tree to grow; great beyond all searching, beyond all bound — day after day I seek Your face.
items.translit: yoshev bishme shĕme zĕvul, umaṣmiaḥ kol-'eṣ yĕvul, gadhol bĕli ḥeqer ughĕvul, yom yom panekha ʾăshaḥer.

items.hebrew: שִׂבַּרְתִּי עַד עֵת בּוֹא שִׁילֹה, יָשִׁיב נִדְּחֵי יָרִים דִּגְלוֹ, אִם יִתְמַהְמַהּ אֲחַכֶּה־לּוֹ, כִּי בֹא יָבֹא לֹא יְאַחֵר.
items.translation: I hold my hope until the time that Shilo comes; he will bring the outcasts home and raise his banner high. Though he may tarry, I will wait for him, for come he surely will; he will not be late.
items.translit: sibbarti 'adh 'eth boʾ shiloh, yashiv niddĕḥe yarim dighlo, ʾīm yithmahmah ʾăḥakkeh-lo, ki voʾ yavoʾ loʾ yĕʾaḥer.

items.hebrew: רָדֹף אוֹיְבַי וְהַשִּׂיגֵם, וְכַדּוֹנַג תְּמוֹגְגֵם, בְּגֵיא צַלְמָוֶת נַהֲגֵם, תָּאֳרָם מִשְּׁחוֹר שַׁחֵר.
items.translation: Pursue my enemies and overtake them, and melt them all away like wax; drive them through the valley of death's shadow, and make their faces darker than soot.
items.translit: radhof ʾoyĕvay wĕhassighem, wĕkhaddonagh tĕmoghĕghem, bĕgheʾ ṣalmaweth nahăghem, toʾŏram mishshĕḥor shaḥer.

items.hebrew: אַל יָשׁוּב דַּךְ מִמְּךָ נִכְלָם, צוּר מִבְטָחִי מֶלֶךְ עוֹלָם, מִשַּׁוְעַת דַּל אַל תִּתְעַלַּם, לְבַקֵּשׁ רָצוֹן טוֹב שׁוֹחֵר.
items.translation: Let the crushed not turn away from You in shame, Rock of my trust, eternal King. Do not hide Yourself from the poor man's cry; for one who strives for good is seeking favor.
items.translit: ʾal yashuv dakh mimmĕkha nikhlam, ṣur mivṭaḥi melekh 'olam, mishshaw'ath dal ʾal tith'allam, lĕvaqqesh raṣon ṭov shoḥer.

items.hebrew: סימן: שמעיה קוסון.
items.translation: Acrostic: Shĕma'ya Qoson.

items.hebrew: אוֹדֶה לָאֵל לֵבָב חוֹקֵר, בְּרָן־יַחַד כּוֹכְבֵי בֹקֶר.
items.translation: I thank the God who searches every heart, as the morning stars sing out together.
items.translit: ʾodheh laʾel levav ḥoqer, bĕran-yaḥadh kokhĕve voqer.

items.hebrew: שִׂימוּ לֵב עַל הַנְּשָׁמָה, לֶשֶׁם שְׁבוֹ וְאַחְלָמָה, וְאוֹרָהּ כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה, שִׁבְעָתַיִם כְּאוֹר בֹּקֶר.
items.translation: Turn your heart toward the soul — jacinth, agate and amethyst — whose light is like the light of the sun, seven times the light of morning.
items.translit: simu lev 'al hannĕshama, leshem shĕvo wĕʾaḥlama, wĕʾorah kĕʾor haḥamma, shiv'athayīm kĕʾor boqer.

items.hebrew: מִכִּסֵּא כָבוֹד חֻצָּבָה, לָגוּר בְּאֶרֶץ עֲרָבָה, לְהַצִּילָהּ מִלֶּהָבָה, וּלְהָאִירָהּ לִפְנוֹת בֹּקֶר.
items.translation: From the Throne of Glory she was hewn, to dwell within a desert land; to save her from the flame, and give her light as morning nears.
items.translit: mikkisseʾ khavodh ḥuṣṣava, laghur bĕʾereṣ 'ărava, lĕhaṣṣilah millehava, ulĕhaʾirah lifnoth boqer.

items.hebrew: עוּרוּ נָא כִּי בְכָל־לַיְלָה, נִשְׁמַתְכֶם עוֹלָה לְמַעְלָה, לָתֵת דִּין וְחֶשְׁבּוֹן מִפָּעֳלָהּ, לְיוֹצֵר עֶרֶב וָבֹקֶר.
items.translation: Awake, I pray, for every night your soul goes up on high, to give account and reckoning of her deeds before the Maker of evening and morning.
items.translit: 'uru naʾ ki vĕkhol-layla, nishmathkhem 'ola lĕma'la, latheth din wĕḥeshbon mippo'ŏlah, lĕyoṣer 'erev wavoqer.

items.hebrew: יִמְצָאוּהָ מְקֻדֶּשֶׁת, בְּמִצְוֹת וּבְתוֹסֶפֶת, כְּמוֹ כַלָּה מְקֻשֶּׁטֶת, תָּמִיד בַּבֹּקֶר בַּבֹּקֶר.
items.translation: May they find her sanctified, with commandments and with more besides, adorned as is a bride — always, morning after morning.
items.translit: yimṣaʾuha mĕquddesheth, bĕmiṣwoth uvĕthosefeth, kĕmo khalla mĕqushsheṭeth, tamidh babboqer babboqer.

items.hebrew: הַנֶּאֱמָן בְּפִקְדוֹנוֹ, יַחֲזִירֶנָּה לּוֹ כִּרְצוֹנוֹ, אִישׁ לֹא גָוַע בַּעֲוֹנוֹ, וַיְהִי עֶרֶב וַיְהִי בֹקֶר.
items.translation: The One who is faithful with His trust will give her back to him as He desires; no man has perished for his wrongdoing — and there was evening, and there was morning.
items.translit: hanneʾĕman bĕfiqdhono, yaḥăzirenna lo kirṣono, ʾish loʾ ghawa' ba'ăwono, wayĕhi 'erev wayĕhi voqer.

items.hebrew: קוּמוּ לֹא זֹאת הַמְּנוּחָה, מִדַּת רַחֲמִים מְתוּחָה, שׁוּבוּ כִּי יָדוֹ פְתוּחָה, לְכָל מַשְׁכִּימֵי בַבֹּקֶר.
items.translation: Rise up — this is no place of rest! The measure of mercy is stretched out wide. Return, for His hand is open to all who rise early in the morning.
items.translit: qumu loʾ zoʾth hammĕnuḥa, middath raḥămim mĕthuḥa, shuvu ki yadho fĕthuḥa, lĕkhol mashkime vabboqer.

items.hebrew: וְשֵׁנָה אַל תֶּאֱהָבוּ, לְהַקְדִּישׁ לָאֵל אֱהָבוּ, הָבוּ לַאדֹנָי הָבוּ, כָּבוֹד וְהָיָה הַבֹּקֶר.
items.translation: Do not be lovers of sleep; love instead to hallow God. Give to my Lord, O give Him glory — and morning it will be.
items.translit: wĕshena ʾal teʾĕhavu, lĕhaqdish laʾel ʾĕhavu, havu laʾdhonay havu, kavodh wĕhaya habboqer.

items.hebrew: סָלּוּהָ כְּמוֹ עֲרֵמִים, נֶפֶשׁ בְּהֵמוֹת נִרְדָּמִים, יַעַן לְמִשְׁטַח חֲרָמִים, לְסַדֵּר עוֹלַת הַבֹּקֶר.
items.translation: Heap her up like piles of grain, the beastly soul of those who slumber — fit only for the spreading of nets — and set in order the morning's offering.
items.translit: salluha kĕmo 'ăremim, nefesh bĕhemoth nirdamim, ya'an lĕmishṭaḥ ḥăramim, lĕsadder 'olath habboqer.

items.hebrew: וְהַחֲיוּ הָעֲנִיָּה, יְחִידָה תַּמָּה וּנְקִיָּה, וַאֲשֶׁר נַפְשׁוֹ לֹא חִיָּה, אֵיךְ יִזְכֶּה לְאוֹר הַבֹּקֶר.
items.translation: And give life to the poor one, the only one, blameless and pure; for he who has not kept his soul alive — how shall he merit the morning's light?
items.translit: wĕhaḥăyu ha'ăniyya, yĕḥidha tamma unĕqiyya, waʾăsher nafsho loʾ ḥiyya, ʾekh yizkeh lĕʾor habboqer.

items.hebrew: נֹעַם אֲדֹנָי לַחֲזוֹת, נִזְכֶּה וּבַשָּׁנָה הַזֹּאת, בְּשִׂמְחוֹת תַּחַת רְגָזוֹת, בֹּקֶר תִּשְׁמַע קוֹלִי בֹּקֶר.
items.translation: To gaze upon the sweetness of my Lord — may we merit it, and this very year, with gladness in the place of grief: at morning You will hear my voice — at morning.
items.translit: no'am ʾădhonay laḥăzoth, nizkeh uvashshana hazzoʾth, bĕsimḥoth taḥath rĕghazoth, boqer tishma' qoli boqer.

items.hebrew: סימן: שלמה.
items.translation: Acrostic: Shĕlomo.

items.hebrew: שְׁפַל רוּחַ שְׁפַל בֶּרֶךְ וְקוֹמָה, אֲקַדֶּמְךָ בְּרָב־פַּחַד וְאֵימָה.
items.translation: Low in spirit, low of knee and stature, I come before You in great fear and awe.
items.translit: shĕfal ruaḥ shĕfal berekh wĕqoma, ʾăqaddemkha bĕrov-faḥadh wĕʾema.

items.hebrew: לְפָנֶיךָ אֲנִי נֶחְשָׁב בְּעֵינַי, כְּתוֹלַעַת קְטַנָּה בָּאֲדָמָה.
items.translation: Before You I am counted, in my eyes, as but a little worm upon the ground.
items.translit: lĕfanekha ʾăni neḥshav bĕ'enay, kĕthola'ath qĕṭanna baʾădhama.

items.hebrew: מְלֹא עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר אֵין קֵץ לְגָדְלוֹ, הֲכָמוֹנִי יְהַלֶּלְךָ וּבַמָּה.
items.translation: You who fill the world, whose greatness has no end — can one like me give praise to You, and with what?
items.translit: mĕloʾ 'olam ʾăsher ʾen qeṣ lĕghodhlo, hăkhamoni yĕhallelkha uvamma.

items.hebrew: הֲדָרָךְ לֹא יְכִילוּן מַלְאֲכֵי רוֹם, וְעַל אַחַת אֲנִי כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה.
items.translation: The angels on high cannot contain Your splendor — how much less, then, can I!
items.translit: hădharakh loʾ yĕkhilun malʾăkhe rom, wĕ'al ʾaḥath ʾăni kamma wĕkhamma.

items.hebrew: הֱטִיבוֹתָ וְהִגְדַּלְתָּ חֲסָדִים, לְךָ תַגְדִּיל לְהוֹדוֹת כָּל־נְשָׁמָה.
items.translation: You have done good, and made Your kindness great; to You each soul will give abundant thanks.
items.translit: hĕṭivotha wĕhighdalta ḥăsadhim, lĕkha thaghdil lĕhodhoth kol-nĕshama.

items.hebrew: סימן: אברהם (הראב"ע).
items.translation: Acrostic: ʾAvraham (ibn Ezra).

items.hebrew: אֲגַדֶּלְךָ אֱלֹהֵי כָל־נְשָׁמָה, וְאוֹדְךָ בְּרָב־פַּחַד וְאֵימָה.
items.translation: I will magnify You, God of every soul, and thank You in great fear and awe.
items.translit: ʾăghaddelkha ʾĕlohe khol-nĕshama, wĕʾodhĕkha bĕrov-faḥadh wĕʾema.

items.hebrew: בְּעָמְדִי תּוֹךְ קְהָלְךָ צוּר לְרוֹמֵם, לְךָ אֶכְרַע וְאֶכֹּף רֹאשׁ וְקוֹמָה.
items.translation: When I stand among Your congregation, O Rock, to exalt You, to You I bend the knee, and bow my head and frame.
items.translit: bĕ'amĕdhi tokh qĕhalĕkha ṣur lĕromem, lĕkha ʾekhra' wĕʾekkof roʾsh wĕqoma.

items.hebrew: רְקִיעֵי רוֹם הֲלֹא נָטָה בְּמִבְטָא, וְהָאָרֶץ יְסָדָהּ עַל בְּלִימָה.
items.translation: The heavens on high — did He not stretch them with a word, and found the earth on nothingness?
items.translit: rĕqi'e rom hăloʾ naṭa bĕmivṭaʾ, wĕhaʾareṣ yĕsadhah 'al bĕlima.

items.hebrew: הֲיוּכַל אִישׁ חֲקֹר אֶת סוֹד יְצָרוֹ, וּמִי הוּא זֶה בְּכָל־קֵדְמָה וָיָמָּה.
items.translation: Can any man search out the secret of what He has formed — and who is there who can, in all the east and west?
items.translit: hăyukhal ʾish ḥăqor ʾeth sodh yĕṣaro, umi huʾ zeh bĕkhol-qedhĕma wayamma.

items.hebrew: מְרוֹמָם הוּא עֲלֵי כָל־פֶּה וָלָשׁוֹן, אֲשֶׁר הִפְלִיא וְעָשָׂה כֹל בְּחָכְמָה.
items.translation: He is exalted over every mouth and tongue, who has done wonders and made all with wisdom.
items.translit: mĕromam huʾ 'ăle khol-feh walashon, ʾăsher hifliʾ wĕ'asa khol bĕḥokhma.

items.hebrew: וְיִתְגַּדַּל בְּגוֹי קָדוֹשׁ וְעֶלְיוֹן, וְיִתְקַדַּשׁ שְׁמֵיהּ רַבָּא בְּעָלְמָא.
items.translation: May He be magnified in a nation holy and most high, and may His great name be sanctified in the world.
items.translit: wĕyithgaddal bĕghoy qadhosh wĕ'elyon, wĕyithqaddash shĕmeh rabbaʾ bĕ'alĕmaʾ.

items.hebrew: סימן: ישראל.
items.translation: Acrostic: Yisraʾel.

items.hebrew: יָהּ רִבּוֹן עָלַם וְעָלְמַיָּא, אַנְתְּ הוּא מַלְכָּא מֶלֶךְ מַלְכַיָּא. עוֹבַד גְּבוּרְתָּךְ וְתִמְהַיָּא, שְׁפַר קֳדָמָךְ לְהַחֲוָיָא.
items.translation: Yah, Master of this world and all worlds, You are the King, the King of kings. The works of Your might and Your wonders — it is fitting to declare them before You.
items.translit: yah ribbon 'alam wĕ'alĕmayyaʾ, ʾant huʾ malkaʾ melekh malkhayyaʾ. 'ovadh gĕvurĕtakh wĕthimhayyaʾ, shĕfar qŏdhamakh lĕhaḥăwayaʾ.

items.hebrew: שְׁבָחִין אֲסַדֵּר צַפְרָא וְרַמְשָׁא, לָךְ אֱלָהָא קַדִּישָׁא, דִּי בְרָא כָּל־נַפְשָׁא, עִירִין קַדִּישִׁין וּבְנֵי אֱנָשָׁא, חֵיוַת בָּרָא וְעוֹפֵי שְׁמַיָּא.
items.translation: Praises I will set out, morning and evening, to You, holy God, who made every soul: holy angels and the sons of man, the beasts of the field and the birds of the sky.
items.translit: shĕvaḥin ʾăsadder ṣafraʾ wĕramshaʾ, lakh ʾĕlahaʾ qaddishaʾ, di vĕraʾ kol-nafshaʾ, 'irin qaddishin uvĕne ʾĕnashaʾ, ḥewath baraʾ wĕ'ofe shĕmayyaʾ.

items.hebrew: רַבְרְבִין עוֹבָדָךְ וְתַקִּיפִין, מַכִּיךְ רָמַיָּא וְזָקֵף כְּפִיפִין, לוּ יְחֵי גְבַר שְׁנִין אַלְפִין, לָא יֵעוּל גְּבוּרְתָּךְ בְּחֻשְׁבַּנַּיָּא.
items.translation: Great are Your works, and mighty; You bring low the proud and lift up the bent. Were a man to live for thousands of years, he could not reckon up Your might.
items.translit: ravrĕvin 'ovadhakh wĕthaqqifin, makkikh ramayyaʾ wĕzaqef kĕfifin, lu yĕḥe ghĕvar shĕnin ʾalfin, laʾ ye'ul gĕvurĕtakh bĕḥushbannayyaʾ.

items.hebrew: אֱלָהָא דִּי לֵיהּ יְקָר וּרְבוּתָא, פְּרֹק יַת עָנָךְ מִפֻּם אַרְיָוָתָא, וְאַפֵּק יַת עַמָּךְ מִגּוֹ גָלוּתָא, עַמָּךְ דִּי בַחַרְתָּ מִכָּל־אֻמַּיָּא.
items.translation: God, to whom belong honor and greatness, save Your flock from the lions' mouth, and bring Your people out of exile — the people You chose from all the nations.
items.translit: ʾĕlahaʾ di leh yĕqar urĕvuthaʾ, pĕroq yath 'anakh mippūm ʾaryawathaʾ, wĕʾappeq yath 'ammakh miggo ghaluthaʾ, 'ammakh di vaḥarta mikkol-ʾummayaʾ.

items.hebrew: לְמִקְדְּשָׁךְ תּוּב וּלְקֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁין, אֲתַר דִּי בֵיהּ יֶחְדוּן רוּחִין וְנַפְשִׁין, וִיזַמְּרוּן לָךְ שִׁירִין וְרַחְשִׁין, בִּירוּשְׁלֶם קַרְתָּא דְּשֻׁפְרַיָּא.
items.translation: Return to Your Temple and the Holy of Holies, the place where spirits and souls will rejoice, and sing to You songs and praises, in Jerusalem, city of beauty.
items.translit: lĕmiqdĕshakh tuv ulĕqodhesh qadhashin, ʾăthar di veh yeḥdhun ruḥin wĕnafshin, wizammĕrun lakh shirin wĕraḥshin, birushĕlem qartaʾ dĕshufrayyaʾ.

items.hebrew: סימן: יהודה. לראש חודש
items.translation: Acrostic: Yĕhudha. For Roʾsh Ḥodhesh.

items.hebrew: שַׁעַר הָרַחֲמִים, לְעַם בָּךְ בּוֹטֵחַ, בְּיוֹם רֹאשׁ הַחֹדֶשׁ, הַזֶּה יִפָּתֵחַ.
items.translation: The gate of mercy — for the people who trust in You, on this day of Roʾsh Ḥodhesh, may it be opened.
items.translit: sha'ar haraḥămim, lĕ'am bakh boṭeaḥ, bĕyom roʾsh haḥodhesh, hazzeh yippatheaḥ.

items.hebrew: יִשְׁעִי לְךָ אֶקְרָא, בַּיָּמִים וּבַלֵּילוֹת, אֵל גָּדוֹל וְנֹרָא, נֹרָא עֲלִילוֹת, שְׁלַח נָא גְאֻלּוֹת, וְלָךְ נְשַׁבֵּחַ, וְנַקְרִיב קָרְבָּנוֹת, עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
items.translation: My Salvation, to You I call, by day and by night. Great and awesome God, awesome in deeds, send redemption now, and we will praise You, and bring our offerings upon the altar.
items.translit: yish'i lĕkha ʾeqraʾ, bayyamim uvalleloth, ʾel gadhol wĕnoraʾ, noraʾ 'ăliloth, shĕlaḥ naʾ ghĕʾulloth, wĕlakh nĕshabbeaḥ, wĕnaqriv qorbanoth, 'al gabbe hammizbeaḥ.

items.hebrew: הָסֵר מֵעָלֵינוּ צוּר, זַעַם וְעֶבְרָה, הֱיֵה־נָא בַּעֲדֵנוּ, צִנָּה וְסֹחֵרָה, פֶּשַׁע וַעֲבֵרָה, הֱיֵה־נָא סוֹלֵחַ, שְׁעֵה־נָא עֲתִירָה, בְּקֶרֶב הַמִּזְבֵּחַ.
items.translation: Take from upon us, Rock, anger and wrath; be all around us, shield and wall. Be forgiving of defiance and misdeed; turn to our plea within the altar.
items.translit: haser me'alenu ṣur, za'am wĕ'evra, hĕyeh-naʾ ba'ădhenu, ṣinna wĕsoḥera, pesha' wa'ăvera, hĕyeh-naʾ soleaḥ, shĕ'eh-naʾ 'ăthira, bĕqerev hammizbeaḥ.

items.hebrew: וְעַד אָן עַמְּךָ, יִהְיוּ בֵין צָרִים, חֲשֹׂף זְרוֹעֲךָ, עַל רְשָׁעִים אַכְזָרִים, אַדִּיר אַדִּירִים, אַל נָא יִהְיוּ לָבֶטַח, גְּאֻלָּה לָעִבְרִים, הֱיֵה־נָא שׁוֹלֵחַ.
items.translation: How long will Your people be among their foes? Bare Your arm against the cruel and wicked. Mightiest of the mighty, let them not rest secure; send redemption to the Hebrews.
items.translit: wĕ'adh ʾan 'ammĕkha, yihyu ven ṣarim, ḥăsof zĕro'ăkha, 'al rĕsha'im ʾakhzarim, ʾaddir ʾaddirim, ʾal naʾ yihyu laveṭaḥ, gĕʾulla la'ivrim, hĕyeh-naʾ sholeaḥ.

items.hebrew: דְּרוֹר תִּהְיֶה קוֹרֵא, לְעַם הַנִּדְכָּאִים, וְאוֹיֵב יְזוֹרֶה, הַצֵּל־נָא חֵלְכָּאִים, עֲשֵׂה־נָא פְלָאִים, וְלָךְ נְשַׁבֵּחַ, וּבְקוֹל שִׁירִים נָאִים, נַקְטִיר וּנְזַבֵּחַ.
items.translation: Proclaim release to the people who are crushed; let the enemy be scattered; rescue the helpless. Work wonders, and we will praise You, and with the sound of lovely songs we will burn incense and bring offerings.
items.translit: dĕror tihyeh qoreʾ, lĕ'am hannidhkaʾim, wĕʾoyev yĕzoreh, haṣṣel-naʾ ḥelĕkaʾim, 'ăseh-naʾ fĕlaʾim, wĕlakh nĕshabbeaḥ, uvĕqol shirim naʾim, naqṭir unĕzabbeaḥ.

items.hebrew: הָשֵׁב־נָא שְׁכִינָה, לְבֵית הַבְּחִירָה, וְהָסֵר מְגִנָה, מֵעַל שֶׂה פְזוּרָה, עֵדָה הַסּוֹרֵרָה, כְּבֵדָם פַּלֵּחַ, וּבְשִׂמְחָה וּבְרִנָּה, לִבֵּנוּ שַׂמֵּחַ.
items.translation: Bring the Shĕkhina back to the Chosen House, and lift the sorrow from the scattered flock. The rebel band — pierce them to the liver; and with joy and song make glad our heart.
items.translit: hashev-naʾ shĕkhina, lĕveth habbĕḥira, wĕhaser mĕghina, me'al seh fĕzura, 'edha hassorera, kĕvedham palleaḥ, uvĕsimḥa uvĕrinna, libbenu sammeaḥ.

items.hebrew: סימן: יעקב. לשבת וראש חודש
items.translation: Acrostic: Ya'ăqov. For Shabbath and Roʾsh Ḥodhesh.

items.hebrew: שִׁירוּ לָאֵל נְבוֹנַי, שִׁירֵי רְנָנַי, שַׁבָּת וְרֹאשׁ חֹדֶשׁ יוֹם זֶה לַאדֹנָי.
items.translation: Sing to God, my wise ones, my songs of joy: Shabbath and Roʾsh Ḥodhesh — this day is my Lord's.
items.translit: shiru laʾel nĕvonay, shire rĕnanay, shabbath wĕroʾsh ḥodhesh yom zeh laʾdhonay.

items.hebrew: יְקַר שְׁמוֹ הוֹדִיעוּ, לַכֹּל וְהַשְׁמִיעוּ, זַמְּרוּ הָרִיעוּ, לִפְנֵי הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲדֹנָי.
items.translation: Make known the glory of His name to all, and let it be heard; sing and shout for joy before the King, my Lord.
items.translit: yĕqar shĕmo hodhi'u, lakkol wĕhashmi'u, zammĕru hari'u, lifne hammelekh ʾădhonay.

items.hebrew: עֹז לוֹ בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ, תְּנוּ חוּשׁוּ לְדׇרְשׁוֹ, הִתְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁם קָדְשׁוֹ, יִשְׂמַח לֵב מְבַקְשֵׁי אֲדֹנָי.
items.translation: Strength is His in His sanctuary; come, hurry to seek Him. Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek my Lord rejoice.
items.translit: 'oz lo bĕmiqdasho, tĕnu ḥushu lĕdhorsho, hithhalĕlu bĕshem qodhsho, yismaḥ lev mĕvaqshe ʾădhonay.

items.hebrew: קְדוֹשִׁים שִׁמְךָ יוֹדוּ, וַחֲסָדֶיךָ יַגִּידוּ, אַף יְהַלְלוּ וְיוֹדוּ, שָׁמַיִם פִּלְאֲךָ אֲדֹנָי.
items.translation: The holy ones will thank Your name and tell of Your kindness; the heavens too will praise and thank Your wonders, my Lord.
items.translit: qĕdhoshim shimkha yodhu, waḥăsadhekha yaggidhu, ʾaf yĕhalĕlu wĕyodhu, shamayīm pilʾăkha ʾădhonay.

items.hebrew: בָּאתִי וְקִדַּשְׁתִּי, שִׁמְךָ וְשִׁירִים שַׁרְתִּי, וְאֵלֶּה הִגַּשְׁתִּי, בִּכּוּרִים לַאדֹנָי.
items.translation: I have come and hallowed Your name, and songs I have sung; and these I have brought — first fruits to my Lord.
items.translit: baʾthi wĕqiddashti, shimkha wĕshirim sharti, wĕʾelleh higgashti, bikkurim laʾdhonay.

items.hebrew: כתבו בשם ר' יהודה החסיד, רב האי גאון ורב שרירא גאון, שמעלה גדולה למי שמכוון בעת התחלת "אדון עולם".
items.translation: It is written in the name of Rabbi Yehuda heḤasidh, Rav Hai Gaʾon and Rav Sherira Gaʾon that there is great merit in having kawwana as you begin ʾĂdhon 'Olam.

items.hebrew: אֲדוֹן עוֹלָם אֲשֶׁר מָלַךְ, בְּטֶרֶם כָּל־יְצִיר נִבְרָא.
items.translation: Master of the world, who reigned before any creature was created.
items.translit: ʾădhon 'olam ʾăsher malakh, bĕṭerem kol-yĕṣir nivraʾ.

items.hebrew: לְעֵת נַעֲשָׂה בְחֶפְצוֹ כֹּל, אֲזַי מֶלֶךְ שְׁמוֹ נִקְרָא.
items.translation: When all was made by His will, then was His name proclaimed as King.
items.translit: lĕ'eth na'ăsa vĕḥefṣo kol, ʾăzay melekh shĕmo niqraʾ.

items.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי כִּכְלוֹת הַכֹּל, לְבַדּוֹ יִמְלֹךְ נוֹרָא.
items.translation: And after all things come to an end, He alone will reign, the Awesome One.
items.translit: wĕʾaḥăre kikhloth hakkol, lĕvaddo yimlokh noraʾ.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא הָיָה וְהוּא הֹוֶה, וְהוּא יִהְיֶה בְּתִפְאָרָה.
items.translation: He was, He is, and He will be, in splendor.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ haya wĕhuʾ howeh, wĕhuʾ yihyeh bĕthifʾara.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא אֶחָד וְאֵין שֵׁנִי, לְהַמְשִׁילוֹ וּלְהַחְבִּירָה.
items.translation: He is One, and there is no second to compare with Him or set beside Him.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ ʾeḥadh wĕʾen sheni, lĕhamĕshilo ulĕhaḥbira.

items.hebrew: בְּלִי רֵאשִׁית בְּלִי תַכְלִית, וְלוֹ הָעֹז וְהַמִּשְׂרָה.
items.translation: Without beginning, without end; His are the power and the dominion.
items.translit: bĕli reʾshith bĕli thakhlith, wĕlo ha'oz wĕhammisra.

items.hebrew: בְּלִי עֵרֶךְ בְּלִי דִמְיוֹן, בְּלִי שִׁנּוּי וּתְמוּרָה.
items.translation: Without measure, without likeness, without change or alteration.
items.translit: bĕli 'erekh bĕli dhimyon, bĕli shinnuy uthĕmura.

items.hebrew: בְּלִי חִבּוּר בְּלִי פִרוּד, גְּדׇל־כֹּחַ וּגְבוּרָה.
items.translation: Without joining, without parting; great in power and in might.
items.translit: bĕli ḥibbur bĕli firudh, gĕdhol-khoaḥ ughĕvura.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא אֵלִי וְחַי גֹּאֲלִי, וְצוּר חֶבְלִי בְּיוֹם צָרָה.
items.translation: He is my God, my living Redeemer, the Rock of my pain on the day of trouble.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ ʾeli wĕḥay goʾăli, wĕṣur ḥevli bĕyom ṣara.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא נִסִּי וּמָנוֹסִי, מְנָת כּוֹסִי בְּיוֹם אֶקְרָא.
items.translation: He is my banner and my refuge, the portion of my cup on the day I call.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ nissi umanosi, mĕnath kosi bĕyom ʾeqraʾ.

items.hebrew: וְהוּא רוֹפֵא וְהוּא מַרְפֵּא, וְהוּא צוֹפֶה וְהוּא עֶזְרָה.
items.translation: He is the Healer, He is the cure; He watches, and He is the help.
items.translit: wĕhuʾ rofeʾ wĕhuʾ marpeʾ, wĕhuʾ ṣofeh wĕhuʾ 'ezra.

items.hebrew: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי, בְּעֵת אִישַׁן וְאָעִירָה.
items.translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake.
items.translit: bĕyadho ʾafqidh ruḥi, bĕ'eth ʾishan wĕʾa'ira.

items.hebrew: וְעִם רוּחִי גְּוִיָּתִי, אֲדֹנָי לִי וְלֹא אִירָא.
items.translation: And with my spirit, my body too; my Lord is with me, I will not fear.
items.translit: wĕ'īm ruḥi gĕwiyyathi, ʾădhonay li wĕloʾ ʾiraʾ.

items.hebrew: בְּמִקְדָּשׁוֹ תָּגֵל נַפְשִׁי, מְשִׁיחֵנוּ יִשְׁלַח מְהֵרָה.
items.translation: In His sanctuary my soul will rejoice; may He send our Messiah soon.
items.translit: bĕmiqdasho taghel nafshi, mĕshiḥenu yishlaḥ mĕhera.

items.hebrew: וְאָז נָשִׁיר בְּבֵית קָדְשִׁי, אָמֵן אָמֵן שֵׁם הַנּוֹרָא.
items.translation: And then we will sing in my holy House: Amen, amen, to the awesome Name.
items.translit: wĕʾaz nashir bĕveth qodhshi, ʾamen ʾamen shem hannoraʾ.

items.hebrew: סימן: מנצור. לשבת
items.translation: Acrostic: Manṣur. For Shabbath.

items.hebrew: יוֹם הַשַּׁבָּת אֵין כָּמוֹהוּ, בֵּרְכוֹ אֱלֹהִים וַיְקַדְּשֵׁהוּ.
items.translation: There is no day like the Shabbath day; God blessed it and made it holy.
items.translit: yom hashshabbath ʾen kamohu, berĕkho ʾĕlohim wayĕqaddĕshehu.

items.hebrew: מִיּוֹם רִאשׁוֹן עַד יוֹם שִׁשִּׁי, לִקְרַאת שַׁבָּת נִכְסְפָה נַפְשִׁי, כִּי בַשַּׁבָּת אֵצֵא חָפְשִׁי, וְכִי יוֹם מְנוּחָה אֶקְרָאֵהוּ.
items.translation: From the first day to the sixth, my soul has longed to greet the Shabbath; for on Shabbath I go free, and a day of rest I call it.
items.translit: miyyom riʾshon 'adh yom shishshi, liqraʾth shabbath nikhsĕfa nafshi, ki vashshabbath ʾeṣeʾ ḥofshi, wĕkhi yom mĕnuḥa ʾeqraʾehu.

items.hebrew: נָגִיל וְנִשְׂמַח כִּי טוֹב לְהֹדוֹת, וּלְזַמֵּר עֶלְיוֹן עַל־כָּל־אֹדוֹת, כִּי הַשַּׁבָּת לָנוּ חֲמוּדוֹת, אִישׁ בַּעַר לֹא יְדָעֵהוּ.
items.translation: Let us rejoice and be glad, for it is good to give thanks, and to sing to the Most High for everything; for the Shabbath is our treasure — a brutish man will never know it.
items.translit: naghil wĕnismaḥ ki ṭov lĕhodhoth, ulĕzammer 'elyon 'al-khol-ʾodhoth, ki hashshabbath lanu ḥămudhoth, ʾish ba'ar loʾ yĕdha'ehu.

items.hebrew: צִוָּה לַעֲשׂוֹת שַׁבָּת כַּהֲלָכָה, אָז מִסִּינַי מִצְוָה עֲרוּכָה, גַּם הִיא לְשׁוֹמְרָהּ כֶּתֶר מְלוּכָה, וְכָבוֹד וְהָדָר תְּעַטְּרֵהוּ.
items.translation: He commanded us to keep the Shabbath by its law, a commandment set in order long ago at Sinai. For the one who keeps it, it is a royal crown, and it will crown him with honor and with splendor.
items.translit: ṣiwwa la'ăsoth shabbath kahălakha, ʾaz missinay miṣwa 'ărukha, gam hiʾ lĕshomĕrah kether mĕlukha, wĕkhavodh wĕhadhar tĕ'aṭṭĕrehu.

items.hebrew: וּמְאַהֲבֶיהָ חַיִּים יַאֲרִיכוּ, וְגַם טוֹעֲמֶיהָ חַיִּים זָכוּ, וּבִנְתִיב יֹשֶׁר הֵמָּה יֵלֵכוּ, עֵדְוֹתָיו בְּכָל־לֵב יִדְרְשׁוּהוּ.
items.translation: Those who love it will live long, and those who taste it have merited life; in the path of uprightness they will walk, and seek His testimonies with all their heart.
items.translit: umĕʾahăveha ḥayyim yaʾărikhu, wĕgham ṭo'ămeha ḥayyim zakhu, uvinthiv yosher hemma yelekhu, 'edhĕwothaw bĕkhol-lev yidhrĕshuhu.

items.hebrew: רָצָה אֲדֹנָי וּבָחַר בָּנוּ, וּמִכָּל־לָשׁוֹן הִבְדִּילָנוּ, וּקְדֻשַּׁת הַשַּׁבָּת הִנְחִילָנוּ, כָּל־זֶרַע יַעֲקֹב כַּבְּדוּהוּ.
items.translation: My Lord desired us and chose us, set us apart from every tongue, and gave us the holiness of Shabbath as our heritage. All you seed of Jacob, honor Him.
items.translit: raṣa ʾădhonay uvaḥar banu, umikkol-lashon hivdilanu, uqĕdhushshath hashshabbath hinḥilanu, kol-zera' ya'ăqov kabbĕdhuhu.

items.hebrew: בשבת בלבד:
items.translation: On Shabbath only:

items.hebrew: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃ בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְיָ אֶת־הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃
items.translation: The children of Israel shall keep the Shabbath, observing the Shabbath throughout their generations as an everlasting covenant. Between Me and the children of Israel it is a sign forever; for in six days Adhonay made the heavens and the earth, and on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed.
items.translit: wĕshamĕru vĕne-yisraʾel ʾeth-hashshabbath la'ăsoth ʾeth-hashshabbath lĕdhorotham bĕrith 'olam. beni uven bĕne yisraʾel ʾoth hīwʾ lĕ'olam ki-shesheth yamim 'asa Adhonay ʾeth-hashshamayim wĕʾeth-haʾareṣ uvayyom hashshĕvi'i shavath wayyinnafash.

items.hebrew: בכל יום:
items.translation: Every day:

items.hebrew: אָמַר רִבִּי יְהוּדָה; אַשְׁרֵי מִי שֶׁעֲמָלוֹ בַּתּוֹרָה, וְעֹשֶׂה נַחַת רוּחַ לְיוֹצְרוֹ, גָּדַל בְּשֵׁם טוֹב, וְנִפְטָר בְּשֵׁם טוֹב מִן הָעוֹלָם, וְעָלָיו אָמַר שְׁלֹמֹה בְּחָכְמָתוֹ; ט֥וֹב שֵׁ֖ם מִשֶּׁ֣מֶן ט֑וֹב וְי֣וֹם הַמָּ֔וֶת מִיּ֖וֹם הִוָּלְדֽוֹ׃ לְמַד תּוֹרָה הַרְבֵּה, וְיִתְּנוּ לְךָ שָׂכָר הַרְבֵּה. וְדַע, מַתַּן שְׂכָרָן שֶׁל צַדִּיקִים לֶעָתִיד לָבוֹא.
items.translation: Ribbi Yĕhudha said: Happy is the one who toils in Torah and brings contentment to his Maker; who grew up with a good name, and left the world with a good name. Of him Solomon said in his wisdom, "A good name is better than fine oil, and the day of death than the day of birth." Learn much Torah, and you will be given much reward; and know that the reward of the righteous is given in the time to come.
items.translit: ʾamar ribbi yĕhudha; ʾashre mi she'ămalo battora, wĕ'oseh naḥath ruaḥ lĕyoṣĕro, gadhal bĕshem ṭov, wĕnifṭar bĕshem ṭov mīn ha'olam, wĕ'alaw ʾamar shĕlomoh bĕḥokhmatho; ṭov shem mishshemen ṭov wĕyom hammaweth miyyom hiwwalĕdho. lĕmadh tora harbeh, wĕyittĕnu lĕkha sakhar harbeh. wĕdha', mattan sĕkharan shel ṣaddiqim le'athidh lavoʾ.

items.hebrew: רִבִּי חֲנַנְיָא בֶּן־עֲקַשְׁיָא אוֹמֵר; רָצָה הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְזַכּוֹת אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל, לְפִיכָךְ הִרְבָּה לָהֶם תּוֹרָה וּמִצְוֹת, שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר; יְיָ֥ חָפֵ֖ץ לְמַ֣עַן צִדְק֑וֹ יַגְדִּ֥יל תּוֹרָ֖ה וְיַאְדִּֽיר׃
items.translation: Ribbi Ḥănanya ben 'Ăqashya says: The Holy One, blessed is He, wished to give Israel merit; therefore He gave them Torah and commandments in abundance, as it is said, "Adhonay was pleased, for the sake of His righteousness, to make the Torah great and glorious."
items.translit: ribbi ḥănanyaʾ ben-'ăqashyaʾ ʾomer; raṣa haqqadhosh barukh huʾ lĕzakkoth ʾeth yisraʾel, lĕfikhakh hirba lahem tora umiṣwoth, shenneʾĕmar; Adhonay ḥafeṣ lĕma'an ṣidhqo yaghdil tora wĕyaʾdir.
